item.title: Bakunyuu Sennyuu Sousakan ~Honnou e no Nikuyoku Kyousoukyoku~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Drop Project
  • 発売日: 2011-08-29
  • スコア: 6.3/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 爆乳 潜入捜査官 ～本能への肉欲狂奏曲～
  • 英語名: Bakunyuu Sennyuu Sousakan Honnou e no Nikuyoku Kyousoukyoku

别名

  • Bursting Breasted Undercover Detective

あらすじ

Japan in the near future

The idea of prosperous Japan became a myth, and people live in poverty.

People started to rumor about an underground kingdom where vicious crimes are organized exists somewhere in this country.

May from “Special fighting force Snake” started investigating on this.

item.title: Bakunyuu Police Chikashitsu no Kiseki ~Nikutai Kakusei~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Drop Project
  • 発売日: 2009-01-12
  • スコア: 6.62/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 爆乳ポリス 地下室の奇跡 ～肉体覚醒～
  • 英語名: Bakunyuu Police Chikashitsu no Kiseki Nikutai Kakusei

别名

  • Bursting Breasted Police

あらすじ

Japan in the near future

Every year, the crimes get more vicious.

The idea of safe Japan becomes a myth, and the police enforcement is no longer working.

Then, “Special fighting force Snake” made an appearance.

The group possesses the awesome force and power over the hard criminals. The heroine Kotone is one of the elite members in the group, with the title of S class.
